description: A flat list of ALL individual thermal property measurements.

file_path.description: The local file path or filename.

polymer_name.description: Name or ID of the polymer. Mandatory.

record_type.description: The specific thermal property being measured.

value.description: The numeric value ALONG WITH ITS UNIT (e.g., '320 °C', '45 ppm/K', '0.2 W/mK').

temperature.description: Temperature AT WHICH the property was measured (e.g., '25 °C' for Conductivity). Null for Tg/Td/Tm/Tc.

temperature_range.description: Range over which CTE was measured (e.g., '50-250 °C').

test_conditions.description: Specific test conditions (e.g., 'Second heating scan', '1 Hz' for DMA).

decomposition_criterion.description: MANDATORY FOR Td: e.g., '5% loss', '10% loss', 'Onset'.

notes.description: Any extra context, like measurement direction (In-plane) for CTE.
